question: After role-preserved and matched role-broken observation pairs are frozen without physical vertex geometry, which literal critical-center correspondence edits distinguish preserved roles, and do those edit constraints transfer unchanged to Bavaria and LOC?

correspondence.coordinateSystem: center x/y normalized inside each frozen observation region
correspondence.transformSelection: minimum kind-weighted symmetric nearest-center displacement under a cKDTree, ties by listed transform order; no role label used
correspondence.oneToOneMutationMatching: after transform freeze, independently within ENDPOINT and JUNCTION, construct each smaller-set center's eight nearest opposite-set candidates by cKDTree, globally sort candidate edges by distance then center index, greedily accept edges whose endpoints are both unused
correspondence.scalabilityReason: selected observations range to tens of thousands of critical centers; cubic full Hungarian assignment is inappropriate and is not required to test local vertex invariance
correspondence.evidenceLimit: sealed CENTER events retain center coordinates, kind and arm histogram but not target center IDs for each arm

editObservables.label: fractional surplus critical centers by kind
symmetric nearest-center displacement without orientation normalization
symmetric nearest-center displacement after blind D4 transform selection
identity symmetric-nearest displacement minus best-D4 displacement
whether best blind D4 alignment is non-identity
whether best blind D4 alignment uses a reflection
mean absolute degree change among sparse one-to-one matched endpoints
mean absolute degree change among sparse one-to-one matched junctions
mean normalized arm-histogram L1 change among sparse one-to-one matched endpoints
mean normalized arm-histogram L1 change among sparse one-to-one matched junctions
mean normalized arm-histogram L1 change among all sparse one-to-one matched critical centers

trainDiscovery.nullShuffle: preserved/broken labels within each physical occupant-family pair preserving positive count
trainDiscovery.selection: largest absolute family-pair-balanced rank effect in Cleveland only

transfer.descriptivePass: same balanced-effect direction in train, holdout and control, with absolute holdout and control effect each at least 0.08

falsifiers.replayMismatch: If selected-observation replay does not exactly reproduce the frozen full-world topology aggregates for every selected observation, vertex evidence is rejected.
falsifiers.noVertexSignal: If preserved and matched broken pairs have indistinguishable correspondence edits under train nulls, no local vertex-edit grammar is supported.
falsifiers.noTransfer: If train-selected edits reverse or collapse in Bavaria or LOC, they are not transferable edit constraints.
